about_the_game:
⁠✦ Midgardr is a solo, turn-based card game where you take on the role of a medieval administrator sent to shape a distant frontier town. Manage resources, construct districts, and carefully select the members of your Curtes, all while facing moral dilemmas and unpredictable events that will shape the village’s fate over time.

✦ Buildings and Resources

⁠Gather wood, stone, and coin to expand your village. Manage your resources wisely: build houses to grow your population, markets and mills to store and produce food, political and military structures to govern and defend. Every urban choice has lasting consequences… and your people are watching. Will they remember you as a generous ruler, or a power-hungry tyrant?

✦ Curtes and Politics
⁠The Curtes is the heart of your domain. Each member brings their own views and influence over village politics. It's up to you to maintain balance… but don’t underestimate fate. Some may fall ill, or even lose their minds...shattering your careful plans in an instant.

✦ Events of Fate

⁠Your village will face strange and sudden events. A miraculous harvest: gift from the heavens or ancient curse? Knights in the woods: refugees or revenants? A strange egg: good omen or the spark of calamity? You cannot escape fate, but you can choose how to face it.

✦ Quests and Encounters

⁠Throughout your reign, six mysterious figures will cross your path. Some will ask for favors, others will plant seeds of doubt, a few may try to guide… or manipulate you. It’s up to you to decide whom to trust and whom to reject. But every choice comes at a cost.

name: Midgardr
short_description: You are a Duke, sent to rule a distant village. Build, protect, and guide your people... but beware: plagues, unrest, and betrayal lie in wait. Choose your Curtes wisely, forge alliances, and face the unknown. Will your village thrive under your rule… or be swallowed by chaos?
